name: Francis Brooke
current_role: Deputy Secretary of the Treasury (performing the duties from April 2026; confirmed August 2026)
summary: Francis Brooke is Scott Bessent’s deputy at Treasury. Bessent had him perform the deputy’s duties from April 28, 2026, while he was acting under secretary for international affairs, and the Senate confirmed him on August 7, 2026, in a 51–47 block vote. He was earlier policy director for House Majority Leader Steve Scalise for nearly four years and deputy director of the National Economic Council in Trump’s first term. In October 2026 he led the U.S. delegation to the IMF meetings in Bangkok.
